method: Plan up to six immutable factual obligations from the question alone, quoting exact literal question substrings.
Fill one ledger row per obligation using the unchanged complete authorized source and exact precomputed evidence-span choices.
Require matching IDs and scopes; abstain on any missing, ambiguous or incompatible declared fact. Compile supported rows directly into existing claims without another generation.
reviewed_fix: Removed unnecessary uniqueness and non-overlap restrictions on literal question quotations. Exact containment, no duplicate entries per obligation and immutable ID/entity/time binding remain. This is a generic interface correction, not a case-specific rule.

capture.scope: Explicit public-development harness only; production logging unchanged

limits_of_evidence: Synthetic tests and exact provenance do not establish planner completeness, entailment, output-budget fit or real semantic quality. Actual results are reported separately.
